queries_run: Astera Labs go-to-market distribution business model change 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 說明公司直接銷售並透過經銷商銷售；經銷商主要負責履約與物流，而非銷售、行銷或技術支援，無通路結構性轉變的記載。
findings.excerpt: We sell our products directly to our customers and through distributors. Our distributors are primarily focused on fulfillment and logistical purposes, rather than selling, marketing, or providing technical support for our products.

findings.claim: 經銷商依半導體業常見的 DPA 計畫取得折讓，並有標準價降價時的價格保護credit。
findings.excerpt: Sales to most distributors are made under programs common in the semiconductor industry whereby distributors receive DPAs to meet individual competitive opportunities.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋一次未見 2026 年通路或商業模式（訂閱化、D2C、平台化）轉變的可靠來源；僅有低品質模板站，未採用。
